```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Manual Table Header
cat('<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

# 3. The Loop - Using HTML only
for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  # We use JSDelivr but we break the string so Pandoc doesn't 'auto-link' it
  img_src <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", repo, "@main/Capture.PNG")
  
  # Demo Link
  user_repo <- strsplit(repo, "/")[[1]]
  demo_url <- paste0("https://", user_repo[1], ".github.io/", user_repo[2], "/")

  cat('<tr>')
  # We use a trick: adding a dummy attribute so Pandoc ignores the src
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_src, '" width="250" data-ignore="1"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Demo</a><br><a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</tbody></table>')
